title: (No AI) Audible is trying to make it easier to find audiobooks you’ll actually like
author: Jess Weatherbed
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/Audible-audio-discovery-hero-.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Here’s what the new audio discovery feature looks like in the Audible app. | Image: Audible

Audible is introducing an AI-assisted synopsis feature that's designed to help users determine whether they'll enjoy an audiobook before they jump in and start listening to it. The new audio discovery feature combines audiobook samples, AI overviews, and author commentary to give users more information before choosing their next story, in addition to recommended audiobook collections that are personalized to individual listening tastes.

title: (No AI) Google Maps can now create trip itineraries for you
author: Emma Roth
content:
![Vector illustration of the Google Maps logo.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25472454/STK270_GOOGLE_MAPS_D.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Google is launching [a new AI trip-planning feature for Maps](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/maps/ask-maps-holiday-travel-features-2026/) that allows the app to create custom itineraries for you and provide real-time details about each stop. The update, which is rolling out [to the Gemini-powered Ask Maps chatbot](https://www.theverge.com/tech/893262/google-maps-gemini-ai-ask-maps-immersive-navigation) inside the app, lets you plan a one-day outing or a trip spanning several days.

As an example, Google says you can use Ask Maps to plan a day trip for holiday shopping, or have it create a schedule for a three-day road trip with stops for coastal hikes and oceanfront dining. From there, Ask Maps will generate a day-by-day schedule with a list of stops, while also showing your route and numbered pins for each …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1034110/google-ask-maps-ai-trip-planning)
